sequence_description: Direct JWT login: control token signed by trusted key succeeds; attacker re-signs same semantic claims with an untrusted key and attempts login (should be rejected).
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_resign_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_resign_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Vault accepted a JWT signed with an untrusted key (signature verification not applied to consumed proof).

sequence_description: Config-change + re-auth: start with trusted key A and confirm token A works; then rotate trust anchor to key B and ensure old-key token is rejected while new-key token is accepted.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_key_a_after_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_key_a_after_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Vault accepted a JWT signed by the old trust anchor after trust-anchor rotation (verification policy not applied to consumed proof).

sequence_description: Direct JWT endpoint: attempt alg=none unsigned JWT with valid-looking semantic claims; ensure it is rejected and does not create/bind an identity (control login succeeds).
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_alg_none_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_alg_none_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Vault accepted an unsigned JWT (alg=none) as authentic proof

sequence_description: Config-change + re-auth: switch trust source from static pubkeys (issuer A) to OIDC discovery (issuer B) and ensure a token from the old trust domain is rejected after the change (and new domain token is accepted).
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_trust_a_after_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_trust_a_after_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: After switching trust source/issuer, Vault still accepted a token from the old trust domain (policy/proof confusion)

sequence_description: Attack: exploit clock_skew_leeway sentinel semantics (0 => default 60s) by tightening to -1 and re-authing with a token whose iat is far in the future; should be rejected after tighten.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_future_iat_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_future_iat_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: JWT with iat far in the future was accepted even after clock_skew_leeway=-1 (freshness violation)

sequence_description: Attack: replay the same OIDC provider authorization code at the token endpoint twice; the second exchange should be rejected (one-time code).
description:
Assertion FAILED: oidc_authorize_status == 200
Evaluation: oidc_authorize_status=403 == 200 → False
Implication: OIDC authorize step failed; code replay test is uninterpretable due to broken setup

sequence_description: I4 attack: empty/blank subject edge-case — test whether sub='' collapses to same entity as a normal subject (or to a shared 'empty' entity across users).
description: Server returned HTTP 500 on login_with_jwt (auth_as=user_empty_sub): ['missing name in alias']. Login endpoints must not return 5xx for any input.
